Q: How many posts and reels will I get each month?
A: We set the volume in your plan based on your goals and budget. Consistency matters more than volume, so we prioritise a calendar you can sustain with content that performs.

A: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Shorts, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. We recommend the right mix for your audience.

Q: How long before social media marketing shows results?

Q: Do you also run social media ads?
A: Yes. We pair organic content with Meta ads so your best-performing posts reach more of the right people — see our Meta ads agency page.

## Google Ads Agency in Indore
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/google-ads-agency-indore

Akarsa Studio manages Google Ads for businesses in Indore and across India — Search, Performance Max, Display and YouTube campaigns — with keyword research, conversion tracking and weekly optimisation focused on lowering your cost per lead.

Q: How much do Google Ads cost in Indore?
A: You pay per click, and the price depends on how competitive each keyword is. We forecast costs during research using Google’s keyword data, then set a budget around your target cost per lead.

Q: Google Ads or Meta ads — which is better?
A: Google captures existing demand from people searching; Meta creates demand by reaching people as they scroll. Most businesses get the best results using both, with budget shifted to whichever delivers cheaper enquiries.

Q: How fast do Google Ads bring leads?
A: Search campaigns can bring enquiries within days of launch. The first few weeks are spent refining keywords and bids to bring the cost per lead down.

Q: Do you run YouTube ads?
A: Yes — YouTube in-stream and Shorts ads for awareness and retargeting, using creative our team produces.

Q: Can you target only my area of Indore?
A: Yes. Google Ads supports location targeting down to a radius around your business, so you only pay for searches from people who can actually visit or order.

Q: Will you set up conversion tracking?
A: Always. We track calls, form fills and WhatsApp clicks so you can see exactly what each rupee returns.

## Reddit Ads Agency in India
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/reddit-ads-agency-india

Akarsa Studio runs Reddit ads for Indian and global brands from Indore, targeting by community, interest and conversation. Spend more than $1,000 on Reddit ads with us and Reddit assigns a dedicated team from Reddit itself, working alongside Akarsa to optimise and precisely target your campaigns.

Q: What do I get if I spend more than $1,000 on Reddit ads?
A: A dedicated team from Reddit itself. When your Reddit ad spend with Akarsa crosses $1,000, Reddit assigns its own team to your account. They work alongside us on optimisation and precise targeting, while we handle community research, Reddit-native creative, tracking, comment management and weekly reporting.

Q: Are Reddit ads worth it for Indian brands?
A: Often, yes — especially for brands whose buyers research before purchasing. Fewer than 10% of large consumer brands in India run formal Reddit campaigns, so competition is low, and Reddit is investing in India with Hindi and Bengali machine translation.

Q: How much do Reddit ads cost in India?
A: Reddit’s minimum is $5 a day. Third-party estimates suggest typical CPCs of about $0.50–$2.50 globally, and one 2025 India guide reported around ₹8–₹20 per click. We forecast your costs during the audit.

Q: Can Reddit ads target only Indian users?
A: Yes. Reddit supports location targeting, so campaigns can focus on India, specific regions, or international markets if you sell globally.

Q: Which businesses do best on Reddit?
A: Tech and SaaS, gaming, D2C products, finance, education and any brand whose customers compare options and ask for recommendations before they buy.

Q: How quickly can you launch Reddit ads?
A: Once we understand your goals and audience, we set up tracking, write Reddit-native creative and launch — then optimise weekly. Book a free 30-minute audit call to start.

## ChatGPT Ads Agency in India
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/chatgpt-ads-agency-india

Akarsa Studio is an AI-driven marketing agency in Indore that plans, launches and optimises ChatGPT ads for Indian businesses. ChatGPT ads went live in India on 27 August 2026. They appear below answers for logged-in adults on the Free and Go plans, and self-serve buying starts at ₹725 a day.

Q: Are ChatGPT ads available in India?
A: Yes. OpenAI rolled out ChatGPT ads in India on 27 August 2026, and the self-serve ChatGPT Ads Manager opened to Indian businesses on 4 September 2026.

Q: How much do ChatGPT ads cost in India?
A: Daily budgets start at ₹725. What you actually pay per lead depends on your category, offer and targeting — we start close to the minimum, measure cost per enquiry, then scale what works.

Q: Who sees ChatGPT ads?
A: Logged-in adults on ChatGPT’s Free and Go plans. Users on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education plans don’t see ads, and ads are never shown to anyone under 18.

Q: Do ChatGPT ads change ChatGPT’s answers?
A: No. OpenAI says ads don’t influence responses. They appear below the answer, clearly labelled and visually separated, and advertisers never get access to conversations.

Q: Can a small business in Indore run ChatGPT ads?
A: Yes. With self-serve buying from ₹725 a day, a café, gym, clinic or coaching centre can test ChatGPT ads without an enterprise budget. Local intent questions are often the cheapest to win.

Q: Why use an agency for ChatGPT ads?
A: The format is new, so most teams are still guessing. We bring conversational copywriting, offer design, lead tracking and weekly optimisation — and we already run performance campaigns on Meta, Google and Reddit.

## Influencer Marketing Agency in Indore
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/influencer-marketing-agency-indore

Akarsa Studio is an influencer marketing agency in Indore that finds the right creators, briefs them, manages content and approvals, and tracks results. We choose creators by audience fit and engagement — not just follower count — for brands in Indore and across India.

Q: How much does influencer marketing cost in Indore?
A: It depends on the number and size of creators, deliverables and usage rights. Local micro-creators are very cost-effective; we build a plan around your budget.

Q: Micro or macro influencers — which is better?
A: Micro-influencers usually deliver higher engagement and trust for local and niche brands; macro creators deliver reach. Many campaigns combine both.

Q: How do you find the right influencers?
A: We assess audience location, engagement quality, content style and past brand work, not just follower counts.

Q: What’s the difference between UGC and influencer marketing?
A: Influencers post to their own audience; UGC creators make content for your brand to post or use in ads. We offer both — see our UGC page.

Q: How do you measure influencer campaign results?
A: With tracked links, discount codes and WhatsApp enquiries per creator, alongside reach and engagement.

Q: Do you work with creators outside Indore?
A: Yes. We run creator campaigns across India.

## ChatGPT Ads in India (2026): Launch Date, Cost, Eligibility & How to Start
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/insights/chatgpt-ads-india-guide

ChatGPT ads launched in India on 27 August 2026. They show below ChatGPT’s answers to logged-in adults on the Free and Go plans, are clearly labelled, and never appear for users under 18 or next to sensitive topics. Businesses can buy them self-serve through ChatGPT Ads Manager, open since 4 September 2026, with daily budgets from ₹725.

Key takeaways:
- Launched in India: 27 August 2026 (India is OpenAI’s second-largest market).
- Self-serve ChatGPT Ads Manager: open since 4 September 2026.
- Minimum daily budget: ₹725.
- Shown to logged-in adults on Free and Go plans; paid plans are ad-free.
- Ads sit below answers, are labelled, and don’t change ChatGPT’s responses.
- Launch agency partners: WPP and Omnicom (non-exclusive).

Q: When did ChatGPT ads launch in India?
A: On 27 August 2026. The self-serve ChatGPT Ads Manager opened on 4 September 2026.

Q: What is the minimum budget for ChatGPT ads in India?
A: Daily budgets start at ₹725.

Q: Do ChatGPT Plus users see ads?
A: No. Only logged-in adults on the Free and Go plans see ads; Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education are ad-free.

Q: Can advertisers see my ChatGPT conversations?
A: No. Advertisers only get aggregate data such as impressions and clicks.

Q: Which agencies run ChatGPT ads in India?
A: OpenAI named WPP and Omnicom as non-exclusive launch partners. Independent agencies like Akarsa Studio in Indore also plan and run ChatGPT ads for Indian businesses through the self-serve Ads Manager.

## Reddit Ads Cost in India (2026): CPC, CPM, Budgets & Is It Worth It?
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/insights/reddit-ads-cost-india

Reddit ads have a minimum budget of $5 a day. Third-party 2026 estimates put typical CPCs around $0.50–$2.50 and CPMs around $3–$9 globally, and one 2025 India guide reported roughly ₹8–₹20 per click and ₹50–₹120 per 1,000 impressions. Reddit doesn’t publish official averages, so test with a small budget and measure your own cost per lead.

Key takeaways:
- Minimum: $5/day; bids from about $0.20.
- Global 2026 estimates: CPC ~$0.50–$2.50, CPM ~$3–$9 (third-party).
- India (2025 guide): ~₹8–₹20 CPC, ~₹50–₹120 CPM.
- Fewer than 10% of large consumer brands in India run formal Reddit campaigns.
- Target by community, interest, keyword and location.
- Akarsa offer: spend $1,000+ with us and get a dedicated team from Reddit.

Q: What is the minimum budget for Reddit ads?
A: Reddit’s stated minimum is $5 per day.

Q: What is the average CPC for Reddit ads in India?
A: One 2025 India guide reported roughly ₹8–₹20 per click. Global 2026 estimates range around $0.50–$2.50. Reddit doesn’t publish official averages.

Q: Are Reddit ads cheaper than Meta ads?
A: It depends on the category. Reddit often has less competition in India, but costs vary widely by community. Testing both is the only reliable comparison.

Q: Can I target Indian users on Reddit?
A: Yes. Reddit supports location targeting, alongside community, interest and keyword targeting.

Q: Does Akarsa Studio run Reddit ads?
A: Yes. Spend more than $1,000 on Reddit ads with Akarsa Studio and Reddit assigns a dedicated team from Reddit to your account, working alongside us to optimise and precisely target your campaigns.

## Meta Ads Cost in India (2026): CPM, CPC & Cost per Lead — With Real Campaign Data
URL: https://www.akarsaone.xyz/insights/meta-ads-cost-india

Meta ads in India typically cost about ₹50–₹120 per 1,000 impressions and ₹8–₹25 per click, with cost per lead around ₹150–₹400 in many categories — higher in real estate (₹600–₹1,200) and finance (₹350–₹700), according to third-party benchmarks. In one Akarsa Studio campaign, ₹30,000 produced 52 enquiries at ₹577 each.

Key takeaways:
- CPM: ~₹50–₹120 (third-party benchmarks).
- CPC: ~₹8–₹25 across most industries.
- Cost per lead: ~₹150–₹400; real estate ₹600–₹1,200; finance ₹350–₹700.
- Our data: ₹30,000 → 52 enquiries = ₹577 per enquiry (down from ₹7,500).
- Industry, offer and creative move costs more than averages do.

Q: How much do Meta ads cost per day in India?
A: You can start with a small daily budget, but the right amount depends on your target cost per lead and how many leads you need. Benchmarks suggest ₹8–₹25 per click and ₹150–₹400 per lead in many categories.

Q: What is a good cost per lead on Meta ads in India?
A: It varies by industry — around ₹150–₹400 in many categories, ₹600–₹1,200 in real estate. In one of our campaigns we achieved ₹577 per enquiry, down from ₹7,500.

Q: Why is my Meta ads cost per lead so high?
A: The usual causes are weak offers, untested creative and poor tracking that makes Meta optimise for the wrong action.

Q: Are Meta ads worth it for small businesses in Indore?
A: Yes, when campaigns are built around a clear offer, good creative and accurate tracking. Click-to-WhatsApp ads work especially well for local businesses.

Q: Can Akarsa Studio manage my Meta ads?
A: Yes. We’re a Meta ads agency in Indore running Facebook and Instagram campaigns for brands across India.
